Before we begin

A few things
you may wonder.

Do you photograph weddings outside Amsterdam?

Yes. I’m based in the Netherlands and work throughout the Netherlands. For weddings in Belgium and other European destinations, travel and any overnight stay are discussed in advance.

We’re not used to being photographed. Is that a problem?

Not at all. We’ll keep the portraits relaxed, with clear guidance when you need it and room to be together. You do not need to learn poses beforehand.

How much wedding coverage should we book?

Start with the moments you want photographed: preparations, the ceremony, portraits, dinner and the party. Share the outline of your day and we’ll work out suitable coverage. The price page shows provisional 6, 8 and 10-hour collections.

How do we check our date?

Use the enquiry form to share your date, venue or city and plans. You can choose how you would like a reply. A booking is confirmed only after scope, price and terms have been agreed.

Planning your session

A little preparation.

How many hours of wedding photography do you need?

Work backwards from the moments you want to keep. A six-hour collection and a ten-hour collection do not tell exactly the same part of a wedding day. The right choice depends on your timetable, travel and priorities.

Read the guide ↗︎

What if it rains on your photoshoot day?

Make a weather plan before the day arrives. Cloud, a light shower and persistent rain call for different decisions. The aim is a session you can enjoy, with the final location and any changes agreed together.
